criteria.statement: At 390x844 with 5 cards attached, the composer and Send Request stay inside the first viewport
The attached-card list is a bounded strip and/or region-scrolled list, not a growing vertical stack
Card search input and Scan button each measure >=44px in their smaller dimension
Answered state shows real card names, real prices, and real AI answer copy
Desktop composition respects the min(48rem, 92vw) shell width cap
Page theme is visually consistent with slice C's token/motif system
Page embeds or links the slice-B before screenshot for Quick Question
No official Wizards of the Coast artwork appears anywhere on the page
Cleanup evidence recorded: browser closed, owned server stopped, ports released, capture path recorded
